question: In which session of the Indian National Congress was the resolution declaring Poorna Swaraj passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lahore session:-**

 
 
• **The resolution declaring Poorna Swaraj was passed in the Lahore session of the Indian National Congress.**
 
• The Lahore session was held in December 1929.
 
• The resolution was introduced by Jawaharlal Nehru and seconded by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
 
• The resolution demanded complete independence from British rule and the establishment of a sovereign republic.
 
• The Lahore session is also famous for the display of the Indian tricolour flag, which was adopted as the national flag of India in 1947. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcutta session:-**

 
 
• The Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress was held in 1906 and is famous for the announcement of the Swadeshi movement.
 
 
 
• **Bombay session:-**
 
 
• The Bombay session of the Indian National Congress was held in 1885, which marked the beginning of the Indian National Congress.
 
 
 
• **Madras session:-**
 
 
• The Madras session of the Indian National Congress was held in 1908 and is famous for the adoption of the resolution on Swaraj.
